instructions_to_main_agent: Import Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono in index.css or App.js.
Implement the cinematic GSAP / Lenis / Framer Motion scroll-driven animation for the iPhone 3D mockup.
Style all primary cards using deep blue (#0A122C) with thin glowing electric borders and subtle glass overlay.
Ensure every interactive input, button, and widget card includes explicit data-testid attributes.
Wire the 'Notify Me' email form to POST to the FastAPI backend with sonner toast feedback for success/failure.
Use raw HTML and Tailwind CSS for marketing layouts, avoiding standard Vercel default styling.
